spec_url.description: URL of an OpenAPI/Swagger document (e.g. https://api.example.com/openapi.json)

docs_url.description: URL of an HTML API-docs page (Swagger UI / Redoc / springdoc). The linked spec is auto-detected and fetched.

codebase_path.description: Local directory to search for an existing openapi/swagger spec file (openapi.json/.yaml, swagger.json/.yaml, api-docs.json).

name.description: ApiContext name to store under. Defaults to the spec's info.title (slugged), else the host.

description.description: Optional human-readable description. Defaults to the spec's info.title.

kind.description: Its data kind, one of the closed list in the graph ((:ApiKind): news-feed, reference-catalog, forecast, dataset, job-postings, device-state, code-hosting, search, advisories). Omit it and pass no topics to let the tagger (nimble) propose tags for an untagged API; "" clears.

topics.description: The (:Topic) names it serves (0..n); [] for none (weather, a model catalog). A `search` API serves none. Replaces the stored set.

prune.description: When true, delete stored endpoints of this API that are NOT present in this ingest — turning re-ingest into a true sync (a route removed from the source disappears). Default false (upsert only). Use for a keep-in-sync schedule.
